endpoints.summary: Search Shodan for exposed devices matching a query. Supports filters like 'port:', 'country:', 'org:', 'product:', 'os:', 'vuln:'. Consumes 1 query credit per page.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Shodan search query, e.g. 'apache country:US' or 'port:22 org:google'

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: page number, 100 results per page (default 1)

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: comma-separated facets for a breakdown, e.g. 'country,port,org'

parameters.name: minify
parameters.description: true to return only basic host info per match

endpoints.summary: Return all Shodan information for a host by IP: open ports, service banners, vulnerabilities, and SSL certificates.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: the IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up, e.g. '8.8.8.8'

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: true to include all historical banners

parameters.name: minify
parameters.description: true to return only basic host info without banners

endpoints.summary: Count the number of results for a search query without consuming query credits or returning individual results.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Shodan search query

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: comma-separated facets for a breakdown, e.g. 'country:10,port:5'

endpoints.summary: Resolve hostnames to IP addresses (forward DNS lookup).

parameters.name: hostnames
parameters.description: comma-separated hostnames, e.g. 'google.com,facebook.com'

endpoints.summary: Look up the hostnames that point to a set of IP addresses (reverse DNS lookup).

parameters.name: ips
parameters.description: comma-separated IP addresses, e.g. '8.8.8.8,1.1.1.1'

endpoints.summary: Return DNS information and subdomains for a domain. Consumes 1 query credit.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: the domain name to look up, e.g. 'google.com'

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: true to include historical DNS data

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: filter by DNS record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, NS, etc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: page number for paginating results

endpoints.summary: Request Shodan to crawl (scan) specific IPs or CIDR ranges on demand. Each IP consumes 1 scan credit. Pass a JSON body {"ips": "8.8.8.8,1.1.1.1/24"} or the ips query parameter.

parameters.name: ips
parameters.description: comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges to scan, e.g. '8.8.8.8,1.1.1.1/24'

endpoints.summary: Check the status of a previously submitted on-demand scan. The {id} path parameter requires a scan id — call shodan_scan first to obtain it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: the scan id returned by shodan_scan; call shodan_scan first to obtain it

endpoints.summary: List all of the on-demand scans that are currently active on the account.
Create a network alert that monitors an IP range for changes. Pass a JSON body {"name": "...", "filters": {"ip": "198.20.0.0/16"}, "expires": 0}.
List all of the network alerts that are active on the account.
Return the details of a specific network alert. The {id} path parameter requires an alert id — call shodan_alert_list first to obtain it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: the alert id; call shodan_alert_list first to obtain it

endpoints.summary: Delete a network alert. The {id} path parameter requires an alert id — call shodan_alert_list first to obtain it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: the alert id to delete; call shodan_alert_list first to obtain it

endpoints.summary: List the available network alert trigger types (e.g. new services, industrial control systems, vulnerabilities).
List all ports that Shodan crawls on the Internet.
List all protocols that can be used when performing on-demand Internet scans.
List all the search filters that can be used in the Shodan host search query.
List all the facets that can be used to get aggregate breakdowns of search results.
Return API plan information for the configured key: query credits, scan credits, and plan limits.
Return account information associated with the configured API key (display name, membership, creation date).
Return your current public IP address as seen by Shodan.
Calculate the probability that an IP is a honeypot, from 0.0 (not a honeypot) to 1.0 (honeypot).

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: the IP address to score, e.g. '8.8.8.8'

endpoints.summary: Browse the directory of saved search queries that Shodan users have shared.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: page number, 10 results per page (default 1)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: sort order: 'votes' or 'timestamp'

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: sort direction: 'asc' or 'desc'

endpoints.summary: Search the directory of saved search queries shared by Shodan users.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: search term for the saved-query directory

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: page number for paginating results

endpoints.summary: Search the Shodan Exploits database (Exploit-DB, Metasploit, CVE, and more). Consumes 1 query credit.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: exploit search query with filters like 'cve:CVE-2021-44228', 'author:', 'platform:', 'type:'

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: page number, 100 results per page (default 1)

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: comma-separated facets for a breakdown: author, platform, port, source, type

endpoints.summary: Count exploits matching a query in the Shodan Exploits database without returning individual results.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: exploit search query, e.g. 'cve:CVE-2021-44228' or 'platform:windows'

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: comma-separated facets for an aggregate breakdown

endpoints.summary: Look up a single CVE by its identifier in Shodan CVEDB: returns CVSS, EPSS, KEV status, references, and affected CPEs. The {cve_id} path parameter requires a CVE identifier such as 'CVE-2021-44228'.

parameters.name: cve_id
parameters.description: the CVE identifier to look up, e.g. 'CVE-2021-44228'

endpoints.summary: Search Shodan CVEDB for vulnerabilities by product, CPE 2.3, KEV status, EPSS, or date range. Do not specify both cpe23 and product.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: product name to search, e.g. 'nginx' (mutually exclusive with cpe23)

parameters.name: cpe23
parameters.description: CPE 2.3 string to filter by, e.g. 'cpe:2.3:a:apache:log4j:2.14.1' (mutually exclusive with product)

parameters.name: is_kev
parameters.description: true to return only CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

parameters.name: sort_by_epss
parameters.description: true to sort results by EPSS score (descending)

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: earliest published date filter, YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: latest published date filter, YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: number of results to skip for pagination

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: maximum number of results to return (default 1000, max 1000)

endpoints.summary: Look up CPE 2.3 identifiers matching a product name in Shodan CVEDB.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: product name to search for CPEs, e.g. 'apache'

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: true to return only the number of matching CPEs

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: number of results to skip for pagination

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: maximum number of results to return

endpoints.summary: List the most recently published CVEs from Shodan CVEDB.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: number of CVEs to return (default 1000, max 1000)

endpoints.summary: List CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) tracked in Shodan CVEDB. Set is_kev=true to restrict results to the KEV catalog.

parameters.name: is_kev
parameters.description: true to return only CISA KEV catalog entries

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: number of results to skip for pagination

endpoints.summary: List CVEs from Shodan CVEDB ranked by EPSS (Exploit Prediction Scoring System) score.

parameters.name: sort_by_epss
parameters.description: true to sort results by EPSS score, highest first

parameters.name: min_epss
parameters.description: minimum EPSS score to include, 0.0 to 1.0

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: number of results to skip for pagination

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: maximum number of results to return
